decisions.summary: Seed 20's refusal diagnosed as parts_clear holding a household's way 2 ft off its own garden beds where 0246 holds a lane's middle 7 ft off a garden fence; the fix (own beds at ACCESS_HALF_FT) built, then reverted because it re-chose Inashiro's ways into a lane knot the pool test refuses; the patch kept in audit/reverted/
decisions.why: Nothing is narrowed: code and maps are exactly as wave 90 left them (the working diff touches no engine file; the patch applies cleanly to HEAD), so the plan departs from no page. Keeping a change that fails a pool test on the reference map out of main is constitution XIII, and the defect is not dropped (W91-2).

decisions.summary: The defect filed as a found row, E3, files access.py and gap_ways.py, its work the beds at 7 ft together with the gap pass gathering a foot at a neighbor's door end; the row is in ranking.json (scope kept) and found-wave77.jsonl
decisions.why: Adds a row to the ranking and drops none; the stated work moves the implementation to 0246's fence clearance (FR-004). E3 matches FR-003's own definition (a change across modules: the seating's parts_clear and the gap pass), and the row is taken in tier order with the rest (SC-003), as the request orders the work easiest to hardest. The measurement (m:wave91-own-beds-at-the-fence) names seed 20 in its command.

decisions.summary: The 7 ft fence gap classed MAP DRAWING CONVENTION; wave 89's Decisions Recorded row relabeled from HISTORICALLY ACCURATE to the same
decisions.why: 0246's drawing page says it in its own words (line 25: 'The gap is a map drawing convention, not a measured figure'; its Evidence comment lists the 7 ft gap under convention). A label corrected toward the page; no behavior changes.

decisions.summary: settle.theirs' doorstep exemption (gardens within DOORSTEP_FT of a lane's end) stated as UNRESEARCHED and left as it is
decisions.why: A statement of the existing law, not a change: the function's own claim already labels the exemption UNRESEARCHED, and UNRESEARCHED claims are outside this feature's findings by the spec's ruling. The plan neither widens nor relies on it.

decisions.summary: Seed 10's field-way found row (routed_field_runs) stays open
decisions.why: The reverted patch only made seed 10 roll clean by re-choosing its ways; the code path the row names is unchanged, so closing it would close a finding with no fix. Keeping it open drops nothing.

decisions.summary: No Decisions Recorded row and no review occasion for wave 91; verification the cohort and pool test under the measurement, and spec-fidelity
decisions.why: FR-008 owes a row only for a fix that changes what a map draws or states, and feature 294 owes an occasion only for a drawn change; with the change reverted no map moves. Withdrawing the round-1 row and occasion follows from the revert.
